cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Countries, continents and nationalities: famous places, flags, maps of the world, food and people of the country; no writing.

words.scene: elephants and giraffes on an African grassland at sunset.
more: Dad reads about animals in Africa.
爸爸阅读关于非洲动物的书。

words.scene: penguins on the ice of Antarctica, icebergs behind.
more: Tom draws a map of Antarctica.
Tom 画了一张南极洲地图。

words.scene: a globe turned to show Asia, small pictures of the Great Wall and Mount Fuji on it.

words.sz: Kate 的阿姨住在澳大利亚。
words.scene: kangaroos in front of the Sydney Opera House.
more: We flew to Australia last year.
我们去年飞往澳大利亚。

words.scene: a globe turned to show Europe, the Eiffel Tower and Big Ben on it.
more: We learned about Europe at school.
我们在学校学习了关于欧洲的知识。

words.en: Bears and eagles live in North America.
words.scene: a globe turned to show North America, a bald eagle flying over it.
more: 我们曾去过北美洲一次。

words.en: Kate is on holiday in South America.
words.scene: a globe turned to show South America, a parrot and a rainforest on it.
more: We saw maps of South America.
我们看了南美洲的地图。

words.scene: the Great Wall of China on green mountains.

words.en: Many children play football in Brazil.
words.sz: 在巴西，很多孩子踢足球。
words.scene: Rio de Janeiro beach with Sugarloaf Mountain, a football on the sand.
more: We watched a match from Brazil.
我们看了一场来自巴西的比赛。

words.sz: Sam 的表亲住在加拿大。
words.scene: a red maple leaf, snowy mountains and a moose by a lake.
more: 我们在冬天去了加拿大。

words.en: We went to France by train.
words.scene: the Eiffel Tower in Paris on a sunny day.
more: 妈妈喜欢来自法国的食物。

words.sz: Kate 的爷爷来自爱尔兰。
words.scene: green fields and stone walls of Ireland, sheep on the hills.
more: 爱尔兰有许多绿色的田野。
我们听到了来自爱尔兰的音乐。

words.scene: the Taj Mahal with an elephant in front.
more: We saw a tiger in India.
我们在印度看到了一只老虎。

words.sz: 我们在意大利吃了披萨。
words.scene: the Leaning Tower of Pisa, a pizza on a café table in front.
a flamenco dancer in a red dress in a sunny Spanish square.
more: Sam learns some Spanish words in Spain.
Sam 在西班牙学了几个西班牙语单词。

words.scene: Big Ben and a red bus in London.
more: We took a trip to England.

words.scene: the British flag flying over a castle
more: 爸爸在英国的伦敦工作。
It rains a lot in Britain.

words.scene: the Statue of Liberty in New York
more: We flew to America for our holiday.
我们坐飞机去美国度假了。

words.en: Mum went to Japan last year.
words.scene: Mount Fuji with pink cherry blossom trees
more: We ate Japanese food in Japan.
我们在日本吃了日本食物。
We want to visit Japan one day.
我们有一天想去日本参观。

words.en: Lily learns to write Chinese characters.
words.scene: Lily writing Chinese characters with a brush (just brush strokes)

words.sz: 我们的新同学是巴西人。
words.scene: Brazilian children playing football on a beach
more: We watched the Brazilian team play.
She is from Brazil, so she is Brazilian.
她来自巴西，所以她是巴西人。

words.sz: 我们的邻居是加拿大人。
words.scene: a Canadian boy in a red woolly hat ice skating on a frozen lake
A grown-up French man in his thirties with a striped shirt and a beret buying long thin baguettes at a bakery in Paris, the Eiffel Tower far behind.
more: She is learning French at school.

words.scene: Irish dancers in green dresses
an Indian family in colourful clothes sharing curry
more: I like Indian food very much.

words.scene: A grown-up Italian man chef in his forties with a big moustache and a tall white chef's hat, putting a pizza into a stone oven in an Italian restaurant.

words.en: Can you say hello in Spanish?
words.sz: 你会用西班牙语打招呼吗？
words.scene: Spanish paella in a big pan
more: 我们参观了一个西班牙小镇。

words.scene: Lily in an English lesson, a teacher pointing at pictures
A grown-up British soldier guard in his twenties in a red coat and a very tall black fur hat standing straight beside a sentry box in front of a big palace.
An American family having a picnic in a park under a big American flag.
more: 我们看了一部美国电影。

more: 我们看见了一只澳大利亚袋鼠。
She is from Australia, so she is Australian.
她来自澳大利亚，所以她是澳大利亚人。
